Reference / debug/dumper

debug/dumper#

Detailed dump of any value for debugging, after Perl's Data::Printer: its type, size and everything inside — object fields (private ones too), array elements, map pairs — indented by nesting.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let dump = Dumper(order);
dump.type();   // "Order"
dump.size();   // 3 (fields)
dump.all();    // multi-line dump
Dumper(order).max_depth(1).all();   // nested values as `{...}`

Order {
    id: 7,
    lines: @Line (2) [
        [0] Line {
            sku: "A-1",
            count: 2
        },
        [1] Line {
            sku: "B-9",
            count: 1
        }
    ],
    status: Status.paid
}

Description#

Detailed dump of any value for debugging, after Perl's Data::Printer: its type, size and everything inside — object fields (private ones too), array elements, map pairs — indented by nesting.

Types are runtime types: an empty collection has element type ?, a collection of different types (A | B). Actions, futures and native objects are not looked into. The format is for people, not for parsing.
